lines.text: THE SCHOOL OF THE ELITE... AND OF OTHERS

lines.para: Founded in 1945 to train France’s senior civil servants, the ENA opens international programmes very early on. Soft-power diplomacy: foreign officials trained in Paris will remain, it is thought, friends of France.

1991. Perestroika. The school takes in its first Soviet student on the long programme, a young television journalist. His name is Sergei Jirnov, and he is a KGB officer. A year later he resigns... then takes his former service to court to obtain his spy diploma. (His own account, hard to verify.)

The 2010s. Chinese students are more numerous in the grandes écoles. During a presentation by the DGSE to future ENA graduates, a Chinese student is in the room. The head of the service draws a lesson out loud: what is said here will be repeated over there.
At the end of 2021, the ENA disappears, replaced by the Institut national du service public. The former students remain.
